title: quercus robur subsp. pedunculiflora
intro: Quercus robur subsp. pedunculiflora, commonly known as English Pedunculate Oak, is a subspecies of deciduous tree that belongs to the Fagaceae family. This plant is rich in health benefits, as it is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing inflammation, protecting against oxidative stress, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Quercus robur subsp. pedunculiflora include its use as an anti-diarrheal, antispasmodic, and astringent, making it a potential treatment for digestive issues, muscle cramps, and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
